C1599.title: Hackers Can Control Your PC for Cents: Botnet Case Cracked
C1599.summary: Cyber police cracked a hacker case where suspects exploited network vulnerabilities to remotely control others' computers, turning them into bots or zombies. These compromised machines were used to launch DDoS attacks, flooding targeted websites with traffic or executing attack commands to paralyze them.

references.title: Controlling Your Computer for Just Cents! Computers Turned into 'Puppets', Cyber Hacker Case Cracked!
